title: Announcement Of Major Holdings According To Law 3556/2007

body_markdown:
Safe Bulkers, Inc. (the **"Company"** ), following receipt of relevant notifications on 14.09.2026 and 15.09.2026 from Morgan Stanley, announces in accordance with Law 3556/2007, that:


**On 09.09.2026** , Morgan Stanley, indirectly through the following entities under its control, held:


**(a)** 5,187,422 common stock shares and voting rights in the Company, corresponding to **5.09%** of the total voting rights in the Company, as well as


**(b)** financial instruments which, if exercised, would result in Morgan Stanley indirectly holding, in aggregate, 694,225 voting rights in the Company, corresponding to **0.68%** of the total voting rights in the Company, namely:


•


(i) a right of recall over securities lending agreements, exercisable at any time, corresponding to 544,225 voting rights (i.e. **0.53%** of the total voting rights in the Company); and


•


(ii) an equity swap, expiring on 09.09.2031, exercisable at any time via cash settlement, corresponding to 150,000 voting rights (i.e. **0.15%** of the total voting rights in the Company).


As a result, on 09.09.2026 the percentage of voting rights indirectly held by Morgan Stanley in the Company, through the entities listed below, amounted to **5.78%** of the Company’s total voting rights, corresponding to **5,881,647** voting rights:
